description: This file implements management functions for a TLS Session Manager object, including retrieving, adding, deleting individual sessions, and deleting all sessions. It defines functions for session management based on host and peer IDs and session IDs, using internal data structures and locking mechanisms.

classes.name: PTLS_SESSION_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to the TLS Session Manager Object containing the session table and lock.

classes.name: PTLS_SESSION_ENTRY_OBJECT
classes.description: Pointer to an individual TLS session entry object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE TlsSmoGetSession(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG host_id,ULONG peer_id,PUCHAR session_id,ULONG session_id_size)
methods.description: Fetches a session entry matching specific host id, peer id, and session id.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoAddSession(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSession)
methods.description: Adds a new session entry to the session table, updating its timestamp.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoDelSession(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG host_id,ULONG peer_id,PUCHAR session_id,ULONG session_id_size)
methods.description: Deletes a session matching the specified host id, peer id, and session id.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoDelAllSessions(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Deletes all session entries from the session table.
